name: nextphase-pipeline-view
description: Pipeline view: a pane and status line showing which stage your current piece of work is in and whether a decision is waiting for you, drawn from a snapshot your project's own collector prints.

collector.title: Collector command
collector.description: Optional fallback for every project: the absolute path of a collector program (see the plugin README). A project's own .claude/nextphase-pipeline-view.json takes precedence and needs your approval with /pipeline allow; this option, which you set yourself, does not. A .py file runs with python3.
